description.content: The Tenable Exposure View API enables users to search Tenable Exposure view for their organization's cards or retrieve the details for a specified card. For more information about Exposure View, see [Exposure View](https://docs.tenable.com/exposure-management/Content/exposure-management/exposure-view/exposure-view.htm) in the _Tenable Exposure Management User Guide_.

Returns a list of exposure view cards based on your search criteria. **Caution:** This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `TONE_UI.TONE_EXPOSURE_CARD.READ`, `LUMIN_EXPOSURE_VIEW.EXPOSURE_CARD.READ`, and `AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE` custom role privileges. See [Roles](doc:roles).

query.description:
Indicates whether or not to return Tenable-provided global cards or user-created custom cards. 

If `true`, only Tenable-provided global cards are returned. If `false`, only user-created custom cards are returned. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable Exposure Management returns all cards.
Filters the results by card name.
The order to sort the results by, either ascending (`asc`) or descending (`desc`).
The number of card records to retrieve. The maximum value is `25`. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable Exposure Management uses the default value of `25`.
The starting record to retrieve. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable Exposure Management uses the default value of `0`.

response.name: Returned if the list of exposure view cards was retrieved successfully.

Retrieves details for the specified exposure view card. By default, the response includes SLA efficiency and trend data for the past 30 days. You can modify the time frame using optional parameters. **Caution:** This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the `TONE_UI.TONE_EXPOSURE_CARD.READ`, `LUMIN_EXPOSURE_VIEW.EXPOSURE_CARD.READ` and `AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE` custom role privileges. See [Roles](doc:roles).

query.description:
The start date for trend data. Use this parameter in combination with the `trend_end_date` parameter to define the time frame for the trend data. 

The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z`).

The end date for trend data. Use this parameter in combination with the `trend_start_date` parameter to define the time frame for the trend data. 

The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z`).

The start date for SLA efficiency data. Use this parameter in combination with the `sla_efficiency_end_date` parameter to define the time frame for the SLA efficiency. 

The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z`).

The end date for SLA efficiency data. Use this parameter in combination with the `sla_efficiency_start_date` parameter to define the time frame for the SLA efficiency. 

The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z`).
Filter SLA breakdown data by `REMEDIATED`, `NON_REMEDIATED`, or `ANY`.
Indicates whether or not to include trend events.

The Downloads API enables customers to access and download installation and update files for available Tenable products. You can use the API endpoints to list product pages, list downloads available for a specific product, and to download a file. The endpoints can also be used to determine and download the latest version of a file to facilitate the automation of an installation.

**Note:** The Tenable Downloads API uses a different server URL than the Tenable Vulnerability Management API:

`https://www.tenable.com/downloads/api/v2/pages`.

### Authentication

Like the Downloads website, certain files require authentication to download. When files have a `"requires_auth": true` attribute on the product list page, the Downloads API uses bearer token authentication and requires a valid token in the Authorization header to download the file:
```
Authorization: Bearer AbCdEf123456
```

To access or reset your authentication token, navigate to the [Authentication Token](https://www.tenable.com/downloads/api-docs) page.

Examples of product downloads that **do not** require authentication include Nessus and Nessus Agents.
